newsitem.title: LATVIA: VENTSPILS NAFTA,LASAM SELL-OFF RULES OKAYED.
newsitem.headline: VENTSPILS NAFTA,LASAM SELL-OFF RULES OKAYED.

text.p: Privatisation agency on Wednesday said that it approved the rules of the first sell-off stage of oil terminal company Ventspils Nafta and Lasam pipeline operator.
The agency said in a statement that its board meeting approved rules for selling of the state stake of the two companies, the first step in a four stage privatisation process.
The state's 90 percent stake in Lasam, the Latvian partner in the LatRosTrans firm, which operates the oil pipeline on Latvian territory, have to be sold before merging it with Ventspils Nafta.
The current minority Lasam shareholders, several companies involved in the oil transit business in Lasam, will have first refusal on the state's shares.
